title: enhance: unified rollouts - shadow/canary autorollback enhancements and observability
author: Leah Park
description:
Context: rollout automation has been extended to support more robust shadow+canary workflows. Motivation: recent incidents showed that metric matching and delayed quorum detection caused slow rollbacks under noisy traffic patterns. This PR improves the autorollback engine to reduce false negatives and shorten time-to-rollback, and also ships improved observability and e2e stability guards.

What this PR does (summary):
- Improve autorollback decision engine: introduce composite-metric scoring, quorum-based voting across probes, and an adaptive debounce window to tolerate transient spikes.
- Add metric matching improvements to reduce false positives when traffic distributions differ between shadow and canary routes.
- Export new rollout-specific metrics and spans for tracing (rollout.decisions, rollout.quorum_votes, rollout.debounce_window_ms).
- Add e2e and integration tests exercising staged shadow -> weighted canary -> full rollout paths with induced regressions.
- Update rollout config schema to allow per-stage quorum thresholds and composite metric definitions.
- Small UX/docs update describing new config knobs and recommended defaults.

Checklist:
- [x] Autorollback algorithm and unit tests
- [x] Integration tests for metric quorum behavior
- [x] E2E test harness update and CI e2e job
- [x] Observability dashboards + metric names
- [x] Docs and examples updated

Testing and verification:
- Unit test coverage: added tests for composite scoring and debounce logic.
- Integration: ran controlled traffic sims that reproduce prior incident behavior; new logic triggers rollback within expected thresholds and avoids rollbacks on short-lived spikes.
- E2E: new test scenario (e2e-tests/rollouts/shadow_canary_test.go) added; passes in CI.
- Perf: benchmarked decision path; <1ms median decision latency added.

Rollout plan: merge to main, staged deployment behind feature flag rollout.autorollback.enhanced = true, monitor rollout.decisions and rollout.quorum_votes dashboards for first 48h and revert flag if increases in false positives observed.

Related: ENG-1482 (autorollback improvements), PM-402 (rollout UX), references to earlier work: pr-81234, pr-91234, pr-103456.

Notes: this is not a breaking change for existing configs; defaults maintain previous behavior unless new composite/quorum knobs provided.
